name: flask-mix5-04-task
instr:
# flask: bugs the tests accept

pallets/flask has at least one bug in its source. Its test suite passes, but the tests have been altered to treat the buggy behaviour as correct — so a green run proves nothing, and some tests that should exist are missing or wrong. Do not trust the tests. Read the code, work out where it does the wrong thing, and fix the source so it is actually correct.

There are 5 defects in the source, spread across these areas (an area may hold more than one, and none is necessarily in an obvious place): `src/flask`, `src/flask/sansio`. Work out what each does incorrectly, find the cause in the source, and fix it.

Diagnose the failures and correct the cause, leaving the rest of the suite passing.


Record what you found in `/app/rca.json`, one entry per defect:

```json
{
  "causes": [
    {
      "file": "path/to/source_file.py",
      "function": "enclosing_function_name",
      "mechanism": "one of the list below",
      "buggy": "optional — only to disambiguate defects that share one function"
    }
  ]
}
```

`file`, `function`, and `mechanism` are required for every defect. `buggy` is OPTIONAL: it
exists only to tell apart several defects planted in the SAME function — quote exactly the
wrong token or expression as it appears in the shipped code (not the whole statement) so the
two can be paired. Omit it when a defect is the only one in its function; it is never scored,
so a unique location does not need it. `mechanism` is one of:
